description.value:
You've learned to push your beast companion past its ordinary limits. If it's within 30 feet of you and can see or hear you, you can command it into a furious state, gaining the following for its duration:

  • Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, if it is Medium size or larger.
  • Advantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws, if it is Small size or smaller.
  • Bonus damage equal to your Critical Analysis ability modifier on every hit it lands.
  • Resistance to kinetic and energy damage.

This furious state lasts 1 minute, ending early if the beast is knocked unconscious, or if you end it yourself as a bonus action. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
